overview_description.description: Hyperline is a flexible billing platform designed specifically for B2B SaaS businesses, enabling seamless management of financial operations from quote to cash. The platform allows users to set prices and manage billing without writing a single line of code, aiming to streamline financial processes. Hyperline's technology is already deployed in many SaaS and other technology businesses serving the AI, construction, healthcare, SaaS, hospitality, travel, and fintech sectors.

about_short_description.short_description: Hyperline is a revenue platform that manages billing, subscriptions, payments, and revenue workflows for B2B SaaS businesses.

product.name: Hyperline Billing Platform
product.description: A cloud-based revenue management platform for B2B SaaS companies that automates pricing, billing, invoicing, and payment collection.

product.name: Usage-Based Pricing and Metering
product.description: A feature that ingests raw usage data to calculate accurate invoices based on consumption for usage-based pricing models.

product.name: Subscription Management
product.description: A flexible subscription management system supporting various pricing models, currencies, and payment intervals.

product.name: Invoicing and Tax Compliance
product.description: A comprehensive invoicing system that handles recurring and one-off invoices with multi-language and VAT support.

product.name: Payment Orchestration and Integration
product.description: Integration with multiple payment providers to facilitate credit card, direct debit, and offline bank transfer payments.

product.name: CRM and Accounting Integrations
product.description: Seamless synchronization with CRM and accounting systems to automate data transfer and subscription management.
